main_text.p: Perdidit: Futurum, ואבדך Et perdidi te, Ezech.28.16. pro ואבדך euphoniae causa. Hiph.Praeterit. והאביד Et perdet, Num.24.19. Fut. אבדם Perdam, Jerem.46.8. א radicali abjecto, & Cholem ex forma Kal, vel certe Chaldaica, assumpto. Chald. Infinit. להובדה Ad perdendum, Dan.2.12. & in Aleph, להובדא v.24. Futurum, תהובד Perdes, v.24. יהובדון Perderent, v.18. in quibus א radicale mutatum in ו; & ה characteristicum ex Hebraismo servatum, loco א. Hoph. Praeterit. הובד Perditum fuit; Dan.7.11.
אבר m. Perditio, Num.24.20. Psal.119.176. Quibusdam manet Particip. Kal. Est forma שרק Vitis generosa.
אבֵרה f. Res perdita, sive amissa, Levit.6.v.3. Construct., לכל־אבדת אחיך Omnis rei amissae fratris tui, Deut.22.v.3.
אבדון m. Perditio; Perditionis locus, Inferius, Job 28.22. Prov.15.11.
אבדה f. Idem, Prov.27.20. quod legitur אבדו.
אבדן m. Idem: Constr. באבדן מולדתי In perditionem cognationis mea, Esth.8.6. juxta Aben Ezram.
אבדן m. Idem, Esth.9.5. quod juxta R.D.Kimchi possit esse Infinitum Pihel, cum י paragogico, & Dagesch ejecto.

אבה Voluit, Acquievit: Construitur saepe cum Dat. & fere addita negatione: Praet. לא אבה לי Non acquievit mihi, Psalm.81.12. ולא אבוא Et non voluerunt, Jes.28.12. cum א paragog. Fut. אל תבא Ne acquiescito, Prov.1.10. ubi prima radicalis abjecta, & tertia in א mutata est.

אב m. Pater, à propensa Voluntate erga liberos, quasi Benevolus dictus: Item Author, Inventor primus, Gen.4.v.20. Doctor, 2.Reg.2.12. id est, רבי juxta paraphrasten Chaldaeum: Socer, affinitate pater, 1.Sam.24.12. Tri-

page.notes: Hebrew forms are uncertain at several points, notably the futurum and infinitive forms in the first entry (ואבדך, להובדה, תהובד, יהובדון), the form after "quod legitur", and the final word of the catchword, which may be "tributur" with the first letters lost. None of these readings is marked [?] in the text because the scan is small. The large headword אבה is set in larger type in the original. Italic type is inferred from the scan and may be incomplete. The Hebrew running head is printed above the text and is not a heading.
